beep-bot-intro: Tap the arrow pictures to make a path. Press Go to help Beep find the shell.
beep-bot-help: Tap an arrow to add it to your plan. Press Go to watch Beep move. Tap Show me if you want a little help.
beep-bot-bump: Oops! Beep stopped. Change an arrow and try again.
beep-bot-shell: Beep found the shell! Great plan.
beep-bot-show: Here is one path. Press Go to try it.
